WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, member_key,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) nv
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT 'members' k, COUNT(*) a, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) b, SUM(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND valid_from<>join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) c FROM fv
UNION ALL SELECT 'rows_dupkey', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_key), 0 FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'fy_dates', 0, 0, 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'joinrange '||min(join_date)||' '||max(join_date), 0,0,0 FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'fy '||fiscal_year||' '||min(calendar_date)||' '||max(calendar_date), COUNT(*),0,0 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' GROUP BY fiscal_year

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn
  FROM dim_member),
j AS (SELECT member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) nj FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'multi_joindate' k, COUNT(*) v FROM j WHERE nj>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'fy25_26_first_versions', COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'home_not_in_store', COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)
UNION ALL SELECT 'home_999', COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND home_store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'cal2025_firstver', COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND year(join_date)=2025
UNION ALL SELECT 'fy_after_load_joins', COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND join_date>DATE '2026-05-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_keyvalid', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.close_date, COUNT(*) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1
